description.en: One strike plunges three thousand feet, as if the Milky Way came crashing from the ninth heaven — deal 9999+ damage in a single hit
description.zhHans: 一击直下三千尺，疑是银河落九天——单次伤害突破 9999
description.zhHant: 一擊直下三千尺，疑是銀河落九天——單次傷害突破 9999

description.en: A hundred battles in the yellow sand have worn his golden armor through; alone he stands against the gale till the sun sinks low — outlast an entire sandstorm
description.zhHans: 黄沙百战穿金甲，独立狂风到日斜——熬过整场沙尘暴
description.zhHant: 黃沙百戰穿金甲，獨立狂風到日斜——熬過整場沙塵暴
